items_all.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
items_all.reader_summary: A transcript can capture every spoken word and still leave users or applications wondering who said what, how to translate it, or how to format domain-specific jargon. Multilingual calls, fast-paced meetings, and medical dictation each need different output: a translation, speaker labels, or correctly spelled medical terms.
items_all.summary_zh: 逐字稿可以捕捉每一個說出的字詞，卻仍舊會讓使用者或應用程式納悶是誰說了什麼、該如何翻譯，或是如何格式化特定領域的專業術語。多國語言通話、節奏明快的會議以及醫療口述記錄，各自需要不同的輸出結果：翻譯、發言者標籤，或是拼寫正確的醫療術語。

items_all.title: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
items_all.summary: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first. The article Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
items_all.summary: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens. Android development is becoming agent-centric too. The article Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 正在向第三方 AI 代理開放 Android Studio。透過全新的「自備代理」功能，該 IDE 現已支援超過 40 種編碼代理，包含 Anthropic's Claude Agent 與 OpenAI's Codex。Google 表示，新的終端機工具還能協助代理以快上 77% 的速度完成 UI 任務，同時減少高達三倍的 Token 用量。Android 開發也正逐漸轉向以代理為中心。這篇文章 Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI teases Dots for Europe, but its Berlin DevDay was really about building a platform
items_all.summary: At DevDay Exchange in Berlin, OpenAI mostly repeated what it had already announced, but it did share a few new details. The AI assistant Dots should roll out more widely in Europe "in a few weeks," and weekly Codex users in Germany have grown twentyfold since January. A clear subtext ran through the sessions and the repeated nods to ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users: OpenAI wants developers to build their businesses directly on its infrastructure. The article OpenAI teases Dots for Europe, but its Berlin DevDay was really about building a platform appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 在柏林的 DevDay Exchange 上，OpenAI 大致上重複了它已經宣佈過的事項，但也分享了一些新的細節。AI 助理 Dots 應會在「幾週內」於歐洲更廣泛推出，而德國每週的 Codex 使用者自 1 月以來已成長了二十倍。會議中貫穿著一個清晰的潛臺詞，並屢次提及 ChatGPT's 擁有 12 億名每週使用者：OpenAI 希望開發者直接在其基礎設施上建立他們的業務。這篇文章「OpenAI teases Dots for Europe, but its Berlin DevDay was really about building a platform」最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
items_all.summary: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech recognition model that handles transcription, speaker recognition, and translation and takes its instructions as text prompts. It leads several benchmarks and uses only a sixth of the active parameters of its strongest open rival. Nvidia is also shipping a dataset with more than 800,000 hours of speech, along with tools for fine-tuning. The article Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Nvidia 已發布 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，這是一個開放的語音辨識模型，可處理轉錄、說話者辨識和翻譯，並以文字提示作為指令。它在多項基準測試中領先，且所使用的有效參數僅為其最強開源競爭對手的六分之一。Nvidia 同時也推出了包含超過 80,000 小時語音的資料集，以及用於微調的工具。文章〈Nvidia 的開源 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 結合了轉錄、翻譯與說話者辨識〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Cloudflare AI服務快取出錯，155次GLM-5.3回答混入他人資料
items_all.summary: Cloudflare公佈旗下AI服務Workers AI的資料外洩調查結果，指出8月27日至9月9日期間，GLM-5.3模型共有155次回應混入其他客戶的資料。問題發生在處理特別長的輸入內容時，Cloudflare已於9月9日完成修復，確認其他Workers AI模型未受影響，也沒有發現有人蓄意利用漏洞的證據。

items_all.title: With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic
items_all.summary: Anthropic manager Felix Rieseberg says the classic coding interview is dead because Claude now solves small programming tasks better than job candidates do. He'd rather see prototypes that show taste, empathy, and principled thinking, since in his words, "hunger beats tenure." That sounds empowering, but it pushes the bar for newcomers toward entrepreneurial thinking and assumes a hustle mentality not everyone brings to the job. The article With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic經理 Felix Rieseberg 表示，傳統的程式碼面試已經過時，因為 Claude 現在解決小型程式設計任務的能力已經超越了求職者。他更希望能看到展現品味、同理心與原則性思考的原型，用他的話來說就是「渴望勝過資歷」。聽起來這賦予了更多自主權，但它將新人的門檻推向了創業家思維，並假設了一種並非每個人帶入工作中拼搏的心態。文章「隨著 AI 編寫程式碼，創業家思維對 Anthropic 的新人來說才是最重要的」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
items_all.summary: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to break into Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software as part of a bug bounty program. items_all.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weights speech LLM with 4.3B active parameters. It transcribes 40 languages, adds speaker labels and word timestamps, and posts a 4.71% mean WER on the English Open ASR Leaderboard. The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items_all.title: Chrome 開始"翻你的郵箱"幫你填表：Gemini 把 Gmail 變填單助手
items_all.summary: Google 正讓 Chrome 自動填充從“記住”轉向“找來”：由 Gemini 和個人智能驅動，Chrome 可讀取 Gmail，按當前表單主動提供訂單號、物流單號、航班預訂編號等信息。該增強填表功能10月底起向美國用戶分批推送，覆蓋桌面版 Chrome 及 iOS、Android 上啓用 Gemini 的用戶，試圖改變十年來依賴用戶自行保存姓名地址的舊模式。

items_all.title: 騰訊燈塔AI正式對外開放:十年內部錘鍊，一句話完成數據分析
items_all.summary: 騰訊宣佈，AI數據分析平臺“騰訊燈塔”正式對外開放，企業與個人可通過官網beacon.qq.com註冊。該平臺過去十年專注騰訊內部自助分析洞察與數據可視化，此次升級爲AI數據分析洞察套件，面向業務團隊提供自然語言問數、看板生成、歸因分析、指標監控、團隊協作等一站式能力。歷經十多年技術積累，新升級燈塔AI已廣泛應用。

items_all.title: 開源圖像生成迎來新突破：OpenMOSS發佈MOSS-Image，主打長文本渲染與可編輯佈局
items_all.summary: OpenMOSS等團隊發佈開源圖像生成模型MOSS-Image，針對海報、信息圖、漫畫及UI設計中文字拼寫錯誤、段落截斷、元素錯位等痛點，採用5B參數單流DiT基座從零預訓練，支持最長約4K token提示詞、中英文長文本渲染及可編輯結構化JSON Layout，旨在提升複雜圖文排版生成質量。

items_all.title: 騰訊混元Hy4、Hy4flash即將發佈，模型能力、思維鏈效率全面提升
items_all.summary: 10月29日騰訊全球數字生態大會宣佈，Hy4即將發佈。較Hy4 preview，Hy4全面大幅提升，強化長程與真實生產力任務，顯著提升思維鏈效率，並首次引入視覺理解。Hy4 flash近期發佈，主打極致性價比，繼承視覺、Agent等能力，通過模型與產品深度Co-Design高頻進化。8月28日騰訊混元還發布並開源新模型。

items_all.title: 智元提出物理AI價值度量衡Worken，衡量機器人有效產出
items_all.summary: 2026智元創新日上，智元聯合創始人、總裁兼CTO彭志輝首次提出物理AI價值度量衡Worken（有效智能工時），衡量機器人自主作業實際產出。公式爲：有效智能工時=活躍機器人數量×自主工作時長×產出效能比。該指標突破單純統計製造數量的侷限，評估機器人能否自主、持續完成有價值工作及實際成果規模。

source_material.title: 智元提出物理AI價值度量衡Worken，衡量機器人有效產出
source_material.summary: 2026智元創新日上，智元聯合創始人、總裁兼CTO彭志輝首次提出物理AI價值度量衡Worken（有效智能工時），衡量機器人自主作業實際產出。公式爲：有效智能工時=活躍機器人數量×自主工作時長×產出效能比。該指標突破單純統計製造數量的侷限，評估機器人能否自主、持續完成有價值工作及實際成果規模。

items_all.title: 谷歌 Gemini 4 Carbon 登頂：59 分奪回王座，"安全感"成主戰場

items_all.title: 鎖屏照片被順走、 53 分鐘攻破Linux！Anthropic內部研究模型連破五大主流系統
items_all.summary: Anthropic發佈研究報告稱，其未公開內部Claude研究模型在Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows和Linux五大主流系統與瀏覽器中發現大量漏洞，並自主串聯成5條可實際運行的高危攻擊鏈。相關漏洞已按協調披露流程報告給各廠商並完成修復，Chrome方面也已向谷歌提交。

items_all.title: 英偉達擬投資30億美元入股Meta，雙方擴大AI合作
items_all.summary: 《華爾街日報》稱，英偉達將投30億美元參與Meta股權融資，Meta擬在硬件上運行更多AI代理。雙方圍繞Meta AI產品Muse擴大合作，Meta下一代AI代理將更多采用英偉達Vera Rubin系統與Vera CPU。Meta擬發股籌最高950億美元建AI基礎設施。CNBC稱，AMD與博通有意合計購至多50億美元Meta股票。

items_all.title: AI 垃圾遊戲淹沒 Steam，Valve 拒當"裁判"：不封禁，只讓商店更聰明
items_all.summary: 生成式AI批次炮製的粗糙遊戲湧入Steam，引發玩家叫苦、開發者不滿，平臺治理受關注。Valve在韓國Steam Indie Connect活動上回應“AI slop”爭議，明確不會封殺開發者的AI工具。業務負責人Tom Giardino表示，Valve不想替創作者決定該用什麼工具，也不願扮演守門人，並點出若遊戲只靠粗製內容堆砌，終會被市場檢驗。

items_all.title: AI 記憶不再"各自爲政"：騰訊網盤啓動內測，要做智能體的共享大腦
items_all.summary: 文章指出，用戶在多個AI應用間切換，文件散落、進度難續、換工具需重述背景，割裂感成新痛點。10月29日，騰訊網盤開放內測申請，用戶可經官網提交。騰訊將其定位爲“通用存儲底座”，希望以網盤串聯生態內AI應用，讓數據產物沉澱，重新連接碎片化AI體驗，網盤不再只是倉庫。

items_all.title: 電商AI模特圖價格不到實拍四分之一，產業鏈加速成型
items_all.summary: 電商平臺AI模特圖漸普及，卻因“失真”“難判版型”遭消費者吐槽。網友稱以往修圖仍能體現面料質感，如今AI生成令人質疑“要賣給AI嗎”；也有人不排斥高質量AI圖，認爲真人展示同樣不真實。亂象背後，AI模特圖產業鏈逐漸清晰，有攝影師報價顯示，AI生成圖價格不足實拍圖四分之一。

items_all.title: AI 數據中心狂吞電力，美國十五年減排成果或歸零
items_all.summary: 彭博社披露塞拉俱樂部內部測算稱，爲AI數據中心供能的化石燃料電廠建設潮，可能抵消過去15年減排成果。若計入規劃中AI項目，到2030年二氧化碳年排放將達21億噸，較2025年增6.18億噸，漲幅約42%。其氣候與能源首席顧問費舍爾坦言，一年半前預測時，規模與影響恐遠不及如今。

items_all.title: AI模式下廣告點擊率已追平自然結果，谷歌正式推進全球變現
items_all.summary: 谷歌將AI驅動的搜索廣告拓展至國際市場，以在覈心搜索廣告增長放緩下開闢新收入。該消息在Alphabet三季度財報電話會披露：當季營收1276億美元，同比增25%，但股價跌8%；谷歌搜索收入同比增12%，低於二季度的17%和一季度的19%。增速持續放緩，加大其將AI功能轉化爲廣告收入壓力。

items_all.title: AI 繪出"雙頭蝦"，科普叢書遭全網下架召回
items_all.summary: 中國農業出版社《南海海洋生物科普叢書》序言坦承絕大多數配圖由AI繪圖生成，這份坦白未成質量背書，反因錯圖翻車。讀者發現第13冊“斑節對蝦”封面及內頁有雙頭蝦，常識性錯圖登上科普讀物。消息由購書者在社交平臺最先曝光，南方都市報跟進覈實。事件引發對AI科普配圖審覈的質疑。

items_all.title: 外國博主用AI耳機當看診翻譯:“直接聽、直接翻，整個交流會順很多”
items_all.summary: 外國博主“Carlo吳（卡羅）”在社交平臺分享看中醫經歷。他帶上千問AI耳夾式耳機，與醫生各戴一隻，用面對面翻譯輔助交流。卡羅稱自己覺得傳統醫學很有意思，但語言始終是障礙。看診時醫生問哪裏不舒服，他只能邊比畫邊說“全部不舒服”；戴上耳機後，兩人開始進一步溝通。他感嘆這是第一次真正聽懂中醫的話。

items_all.title: CVE 漏洞數近乎垂直拉昇，AI 成安全研究"放大器"
items_all.summary: 科技媒體gigazine報道，開發者@0x_Osprey推出網頁版CVE Tracker，將已獲CVE編號的漏洞數量變化製成可視化圖表，顯示2026年以來曲線近乎垂直上升。CVE是全球通用漏洞編號體系，安全研究員、廠商和企業靠它追蹤、通報和修復缺陷。該工具整理公開記錄成趨勢圖，併疊加主流AI模型發佈時間，便於直觀對照漏洞增長與AI發佈。

items_all.title: Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding
items_all.summary: FlashMap is a speculative decoding drafter from Polymathic AI, Princeton and USC ISI researchers. It drafts 16 tokens jointly in one pass and reaches up to 6.14x lossless speedup on Qwen3-8B. The post Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: FlashMap 是由 Polymathic AI、普林斯頓大學與南加州大學資訊科學研究所（USC ISI）研究人員共同開發的推測式解碼草擬器。它能在一次傳遞中聯合草擬 16 個 Token，在 Qwen3-8B 上實現高達 6.14 倍的無損加速。這篇 Polymathic AI 與普林斯頓大學研究人員發布 FlashMap（用於實現快 6.14 倍 LLM 解碼的流圖草擬器）最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: 百度世界大會前夕重磅流出：消息稱其將披露世界模型進展
items_all.summary: 10月28日，《科創板日報》獨家報道，百度計劃近日正式披露“世界模型”研發進展與突破性成果。該領域是全球AI最火熱前沿之一，核心技術是對真實物理環境精準動態建模與未來預測。業內分析認爲，若該技術率先落地自動駕駛，將大幅提升無人車在複雜路況下的場景預測與智能決策水平。

items_all.title: Liquid AI重磅發佈LFM3 多模態模型家族，主打高效專用智能
items_all.summary: 近日，Liquid AI正式發佈新一代基礎模型家族LFM3。首個版本包含六款約2B參數模型，覆蓋文本、視覺、音頻、全模態與決策等維度，均基於LFM3-1.7B-Base，預訓練吞吐達22T Token。該系列採用全新三混合層架構，融合門控短卷積、滑動等機制，主打參數更少、效率更高。

items_all.title: 騰訊WorkBuddy上線「遠程控制」：手機可實時觀看並接管電腦桌面，遠程操作不消耗Token
items_all.summary: 10月28日，騰訊WorkBuddy上線“遠程控制”，由騰訊Edge One團隊支持。手機App一鍵連電腦，實時看並接管桌面；畫面以小窗懸浮首頁或會話頁頂部，輸入框可用，任務跑偏可糾正。全屏橫屏後，手指點哪即點擊電腦同位置；右側有“操作”“鍵盤”“鼠標”工具，“操作”可平鋪窗口、返回桌面、切換畫面等。

items_all.title: Meet Google DeepMind’s Genie 4: Real-Time World Model With Native Audio

items_all.title: Quoting Ted Sanders
items_all.summary: In general, LLM performance is incredibly multidimensional. There's no guarantee of a fixed ordering where the model that is best at math is also the model that's best at jokes. Despite that complexity, much of the variation in performance is explained by just a single variable: model size. In general, models that are bigger will (a) be more performant / reliable, (b) cost more per token, and (c) have better recall of esoteric facts. As you note, our models are ordered: Luna < Terra < Sol < Astra [ ... ] These days, version number signifies a few things at once: the order of release, the relationship to other releases, and the magnitude of improvement. So something like 6.1 would indicate it was launched after 5.6, may share some similarities to other 6.1 models in terms of training data / personality (which is why it's not 5.7), and isn't a giant enough leap to merit the headlines and expectations that would come with a 7. — Ted Sanders , explaining OpenAI's model naming conventions Tags: generative-ai , gpt , openai , ai , llms , ted-sanders

As you note, our models are ordered: Luna < Terra < Sol < Astra [ ... ] These days, version number signifies a few things at once: the order of release, the relationship to other releases, and the magnitude of improvement. items_all.title: GitHub Octoverse 2026
items_all.summary: GitHub Octoverse 2026 I'm at GitHub Universe today (GitHub gave me a free ticket through their "GitHub Stars" program). EVP Jay Parikh just announced this year's Octoverse report, and highlighted these numbers in particular: This is a pretty stark representation of the impact of agentic engineering on GitHub. In 2026, merged pull requests tripled in less than a year to 220 million per month. Commits more than tripled to 7.38 billion per month, with most of that increase in the second half of this year. New repository rate doubled this year, to 30.3 million per month. The report includes new numbers by industry, and breaks out numbers for repositories that involve "interoperability or reverse engineering". The methodology section includes notes about how they did this: Top countries by pushes to public repositories, adjusted by profile location . Pushes from each country were summed across the Octoverse year. To adjust for biases caused by VPN usage, LLM classification was used to extract the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code from the profiles of GitHub users who contributed pushes during this period [...] Industry . Public repositories created 2022 to 2026 were sorted into NAICS sectors by a fine-tuned multilingual embedding model using name, description, topics, and README, from random samples per year. [...] Interoperability . Counts public repositories created each year whose name, description, topics, or README mention interoperability or reverse engineering, or related terms, such as clean room implementation, drop-in replacement, or protocol re-implementation. Tags: github , ai

items_all.title: The October inflection point for vibe game development
items_all.summary: I've written before about how November 2025 was an inflection point for coding agents - the point where Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 crossed a tipping point that meant their respective coding agents became reliable daily drivers for software engineers. I think we've reached a new inflection point in October 2026, and this time it's for vibe coding computer games . Tree Appreciator Emberwick Battle Drones Pumpkin Farmer, aka Quarter Sun Cove Four times as insulting What happens if someone actually puts the work in? You should build a game! Claude Opus 5.5 in particular exhibits meaningful improvements in several areas needed to build a compelling game: 3D modeling Music generation (see Scrimshaw Jukebox ) Game design (!) That last one is particularly important. Models have been able to create something that looks like a game for quite a while now, as seen in my previous experiments . The challenge has been getting to a game that's actually fun to play . Game design is a deep subject area. I won't pretend to be well versed in it - I know enough to have respect for it as a craft. Creating a novel, compelling gameplay loop which challenges players at the right level and provides a satisfying learning curve is a fine art. I didn't think the models could do it. Then I tried telling Claude Opus 5.5 to "Make it a LOT more fun"... and it did . items_all.title: Quoting Terk Terkowitz
items_all.summary: If your work does not benefit from current AI tooling, that is a finding, not a failing. Document why, share it with your community of peers, bring it to your manager, and work to find solutions. An engineer who can explain where AI does not yet help their work is demonstrating the judgement we are asking for. — Terk Terkowitz , An update from Amazon engineering leadership on the role of the developer in the age of AI Tags: amazon , generative-ai , agentic-engineering , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: AI 當黑客初顯身手：Claude 自主挖洞寫利用，53 分鐘拿下 Linux 最高權限
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic 10月27日報告稱，一未公開Claude內部研究模型僅憑初始提示，便自主定位漏洞、編寫利用代碼，在Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows和Linux上發現缺陷並串成5條攻擊鏈。漏洞均已通報廠商並修復。最驚心的是Linux內核網絡棧零點擊遠程代碼執行漏洞CVE-2026-98432，目標爲運行多路徑TCP監聽器的服務器。

items_all_raw.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters
items_all_raw.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weights speech LLM with 4.3B active parameters. It transcribes 40 languages, adds speaker labels and word timestamps, and posts a 4.71% mean WER on the English Open ASR Leaderboard. The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達 發布了 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，這是一個具備 43 億個活躍參數的開放權重語音 LLM。它能轉錄 40 種語言、新增說話者標籤與單字時間戳記，並在英文 Open ASR 排行榜上創下 4.71% 的平均字詞錯誤率（WER）。這篇文章 輝達 Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic 回應加州 Kill Switch 行政命令，支持政府有權擋下高風險 AI 模型
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic 建議加州讓獨立驗證組織（IVO）把發現的風險通報州檢察長，若州檢察長參考獨立評估後，認定模型構成「近期發生災難性傷害的風險」，可向法院聲請暫停其部署、內部使用或後續開發；它也認同 AI 公司應能快速關閉模型，但認為只聚焦關閉模型的法律「可能帶來虛假的安全感」。

items_all_raw.title: Chrome 開始"翻你的郵箱"幫你填表：Gemini 把 Gmail 變填單助手
items_all_raw.summary: Google 正讓 Chrome 自動填充從“記住”轉向“找來”：由 Gemini 和個人智能驅動，Chrome 可讀取 Gmail，按當前表單主動提供訂單號、物流單號、航班預訂編號等信息。該增強填表功能10月底起向美國用戶分批推送，覆蓋桌面版 Chrome 及 iOS、Android 上啓用 Gemini 的用戶，試圖改變十年來依賴用戶自行保存姓名地址的舊模式。

items_all_raw.title: 騰訊燈塔AI正式對外開放:十年內部錘鍊，一句話完成數據分析
items_all_raw.summary: 騰訊宣佈，AI數據分析平臺“騰訊燈塔”正式對外開放，企業與個人可通過官網beacon.qq.com註冊。該平臺過去十年專注騰訊內部自助分析洞察與數據可視化，此次升級爲AI數據分析洞察套件，面向業務團隊提供自然語言問數、看板生成、歸因分析、指標監控、團隊協作等一站式能力。歷經十多年技術積累，新升級燈塔AI已廣泛應用。

items_all_raw.title: 開源圖像生成迎來新突破：OpenMOSS發佈MOSS-Image，主打長文本渲染與可編輯佈局
items_all_raw.summary: OpenMOSS等團隊發佈開源圖像生成模型MOSS-Image，針對海報、信息圖、漫畫及UI設計中文字拼寫錯誤、段落截斷、元素錯位等痛點，採用5B參數單流DiT基座從零預訓練，支持最長約4K token提示詞、中英文長文本渲染及可編輯結構化JSON Layout，旨在提升複雜圖文排版生成質量。

items_all_raw.title: 騰訊混元Hy4、Hy4flash即將發佈，模型能力、思維鏈效率全面提升
items_all_raw.summary: 10月29日騰訊全球數字生態大會宣佈，Hy4即將發佈。較Hy4 preview，Hy4全面大幅提升，強化長程與真實生產力任務，顯著提升思維鏈效率，並首次引入視覺理解。Hy4 flash近期發佈，主打極致性價比，繼承視覺、Agent等能力，通過模型與產品深度Co-Design高頻進化。8月28日騰訊混元還發布並開源新模型。

items_all_raw.title: 智元提出物理AI價值度量衡Worken，衡量機器人有效產出
items_all_raw.summary: 2026智元創新日上，智元聯合創始人、總裁兼CTO彭志輝首次提出物理AI價值度量衡Worken（有效智能工時），衡量機器人自主作業實際產出。公式爲：有效智能工時=活躍機器人數量×自主工作時長×產出效能比。該指標突破單純統計製造數量的侷限，評估機器人能否自主、持續完成有價值工作及實際成果規模。

items_all_raw.title: AI 垃圾遊戲淹沒 Steam，Valve 拒當"裁判"：不封禁，只讓商店更聰明

items_all_raw.title: AI 數據中心狂吞電力，美國十五年減排成果或歸零
items_all_raw.summary: 彭博社披露塞拉俱樂部內部測算稱，爲AI數據中心供能的化石燃料電廠建設潮，可能抵消過去15年減排成果。若計入規劃中AI項目，到2030年二氧化碳年排放將達21億噸，較2025年增6.18億噸，漲幅約42%。其氣候與能源首席顧問費舍爾坦言，一年半前預測時，規模與影響恐遠不及如今。

items_all_raw.title: AI模式下廣告點擊率已追平自然結果，谷歌正式推進全球變現
items_all_raw.summary: 谷歌將AI驅動的搜索廣告拓展至國際市場，以在覈心搜索廣告增長放緩下開闢新收入。該消息在Alphabet三季度財報電話會披露：當季營收1276億美元，同比增25%，但股價跌8%；谷歌搜索收入同比增12%，低於二季度的17%和一季度的19%。增速持續放緩，加大其將AI功能轉化爲廣告收入壓力。

items_all_raw.title: AI 繪出"雙頭蝦"，科普叢書遭全網下架召回
items_all_raw.summary: 中國農業出版社《南海海洋生物科普叢書》序言坦承絕大多數配圖由AI繪圖生成，這份坦白未成質量背書，反因錯圖翻車。讀者發現第13冊“斑節對蝦”封面及內頁有雙頭蝦，常識性錯圖登上科普讀物。消息由購書者在社交平臺最先曝光，南方都市報跟進覈實。事件引發對AI科普配圖審覈的質疑。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Ted Sanders
items_all_raw.summary: In general, LLM performance is incredibly multidimensional. There's no guarantee of a fixed ordering where the model that is best at math is also the model that's best at jokes. Despite that complexity, much of the variation in performance is explained by just a single variable: model size. In general, models that are bigger will (a) be more performant / reliable, (b) cost more per token, and (c) have better recall of esoteric facts. As you note, our models are ordered: Luna < Terra < Sol < Astra [ ... ] These days, version number signifies a few things at once: the order of release, the relationship to other releases, and the magnitude of improvement. So something like 6.1 would indicate it was launched after 5.6, may share some similarities to other 6.1 models in terms of training data / personality (which is why it's not 5.7), and isn't a giant enough leap to merit the headlines and expectations that would come with a 7. — Ted Sanders , explaining OpenAI's model naming conventions Tags: generative-ai , gpt , openai , ai , llms , ted-sanders

items_all_raw.title: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
items_all_raw.summary: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first. The article Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在推出 Gemini 4 Argon 僅兩週後，Google DeepMind 即推出了 Gemini 4 Carbon，該模型在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 中以 59 分名列榜首。Google 表示，該模型專為長時間運行的代理工作流程以及完整的網路防禦生命週期而建構。由於這些先進的安全功能，存取權限最初僅限於選定的網路安全專家。本文 Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board 首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens. Android development is becoming agent-centric too. The article Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: GitHub Octoverse 2026
items_all_raw.summary: GitHub Octoverse 2026 I'm at GitHub Universe today (GitHub gave me a free ticket through their "GitHub Stars" program). EVP Jay Parikh just announced this year's Octoverse report, and highlighted these numbers in particular: This is a pretty stark representation of the impact of agentic engineering on GitHub. In 2026, merged pull requests tripled in less than a year to 220 million per month. Commits more than tripled to 7.38 billion per month, with most of that increase in the second half of this year. New repository rate doubled this year, to 30.3 million per month. The report includes new numbers by industry, and breaks out numbers for repositories that involve "interoperability or reverse engineering". The methodology section includes notes about how they did this: Top countries by pushes to public repositories, adjusted by profile location . Pushes from each country were summed across the Octoverse year. To adjust for biases caused by VPN usage, LLM classification was used to extract the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code from the profiles of GitHub users who contributed pushes during this period [...] Industry . Public repositories created 2022 to 2026 were sorted into NAICS sectors by a fine-tuned multilingual embedding model using name, description, topics, and README, from random samples per year. [...] Interoperability . Counts public repositories created each year whose name, description, topics, or README mention interoperability or reverse engineering, or related terms, such as clean room implementation, drop-in replacement, or protocol re-implementation. Tags: github , ai

source_material.title: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
source_material.summary: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech recognition model that handles transcription, speaker recognition, and translation and takes its instructions as text prompts. It leads several benchmarks and uses only a sixth of the active parameters of its strongest open rival. Nvidia is also shipping a dataset with more than 800,000 hours of speech, along with tools for fine-tuning. The article Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
items_all_raw.reader_summary: A transcript can capture every spoken word and still leave users or applications wondering who said what, how to translate it, or how to format domain-specific jargon. Multilingual calls, fast-paced meetings, and medical dictation each need different output: a translation, speaker labels, or correctly spelled medical terms.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 逐字稿可以捕捉每一個說出的字詞，卻仍舊會讓使用者或應用程式納悶是誰說了什麼、該如何翻譯，或是如何格式化特定領域的專業術語。多國語言通話、節奏明快的會議以及醫療口述記錄，各自需要不同的輸出結果：翻譯、發言者標籤，或是拼寫正確的醫療術語。

items_all_raw.title: The October inflection point for vibe game development
items_all_raw.summary: I've written before about how November 2025 was an inflection point for coding agents - the point where Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 crossed a tipping point that meant their respective coding agents became reliable daily drivers for software engineers. I think we've reached a new inflection point in October 2026, and this time it's for vibe coding computer games . Tree Appreciator Emberwick Battle Drones Pumpkin Farmer, aka Quarter Sun Cove Four times as insulting What happens if someone actually puts the work in? You should build a game! Claude Opus 5.5 in particular exhibits meaningful improvements in several areas needed to build a compelling game: 3D modeling Music generation (see Scrimshaw Jukebox ) Game design (!) That last one is particularly important. Models have been able to create something that looks like a game for quite a while now, as seen in my previous experiments . The challenge has been getting to a game that's actually fun to play . Game design is a deep subject area. I won't pretend to be well versed in it - I know enough to have respect for it as a craft. Creating a novel, compelling gameplay loop which challenges players at the right level and provides a satisfying learning curve is a fine art. I didn't think the models could do it. Then I tried telling Claude Opus 5.5 to "Make it a LOT more fun"... and it did . In the past few weeks I've vibe coded (in the classic sense of the term - no looking at the code at all) four games that I've genuinely enjoyed playing. items_all_raw.title: Cloudflare AI服務快取出錯，155次GLM-5.3回答混入他人資料
items_all_raw.summary: Cloudflare公佈旗下AI服務Workers AI的資料外洩調查結果，指出8月27日至9月9日期間，GLM-5.3模型共有155次回應混入其他客戶的資料。問題發生在處理特別長的輸入內容時，Cloudflare已於9月9日完成修復，確認其他Workers AI模型未受影響，也沒有發現有人蓄意利用漏洞的證據。

items_all_raw.title: With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic manager Felix Rieseberg says the classic coding interview is dead because Claude now solves small programming tasks better than job candidates do. He'd rather see prototypes that show taste, empathy, and principled thinking, since in his words, "hunger beats tenure." That sounds empowering, but it pushes the bar for newcomers toward entrepreneurial thinking and assumes a hustle mentality not everyone brings to the job. The article With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic經理 Felix Rieseberg 表示，傳統的程式碼面試已經過時，因為 Claude 現在解決小型程式設計任務的能力已經超越了求職者。他更希望能看到展現品味、同理心與原則性思考的原型，用他的話來說就是「渴望勝過資歷」。聽起來這賦予了更多自主權，但它將新人的門檻推向了創業家思維，並假設了一種並非每個人帶入工作中拼搏的心態。文章「隨著 AI 編寫程式碼，創業家思維對 Anthropic 的新人來說才是最重要的」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
items_all_raw.summary: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to break into Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software as part of a bug bounty program. Anthropic confirmed access to sales, HR, and IT data but disputes how deep the breach went. The incident shows how vulnerable even leading AI labs are through their external software dependencies. The article AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 網路安全新創公司 Cathedral 作為漏洞獎勵計畫的一部分，利用 AI 代理程式透過第三方軟體入侵了 Anthropic's 的內部系統。Anthropic 確認存取了銷售、人力資源和 IT 資料，但對入侵的深入程度存有爭議。這起事件顯示出，即使是領先的 AI 實驗室，透過其外部軟體相依性也同樣脆弱。文章「AI 代理程式駭入 Anthropic，這家公司可說是製造了最具能力的網路防禦 AI 模型」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Terk Terkowitz
items_all_raw.summary: If your work does not benefit from current AI tooling, that is a finding, not a failing. Document why, share it with your community of peers, bring it to your manager, and work to find solutions. An engineer who can explain where AI does not yet help their work is demonstrating the judgement we are asking for. — Terk Terkowitz , An update from Amazon engineering leadership on the role of the developer in the age of AI Tags: amazon , generative-ai , agentic-engineering , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI被曝將向谷歌採購TPU芯片，算力供應鏈格局再變
items_all_raw.summary: 10月28日消息，OpenAI計劃向谷歌採購人工智能芯片。OpenAI長期是英偉達GPU重要買家，依賴其完成大模型訓練與推理。隨着算力需求飆升，企業正尋求更具性價比、適合運行AI模型的替代方案。谷歌自研TPU近年逐漸嶄露頭角，成爲潛在選擇。此舉或反映AI芯片採購多元化趨勢。

items_all_raw.title: 外國博主用AI耳機當看診翻譯:“直接聽、直接翻，整個交流會順很多”
items_all_raw.summary: 外國博主“Carlo吳（卡羅）”在社交平臺分享看中醫經歷。他帶上千問AI耳夾式耳機，與醫生各戴一隻，用面對面翻譯輔助交流。卡羅稱自己覺得傳統醫學很有意思，但語言始終是障礙。看診時醫生問哪裏不舒服，他只能邊比畫邊說“全部不舒服”；戴上耳機後，兩人開始進一步溝通。他感嘆這是第一次真正聽懂中醫的話。

items_all_raw.title: Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding
items_all_raw.summary: FlashMap is a speculative decoding drafter from Polymathic AI, Princeton and USC ISI researchers. It drafts 16 tokens jointly in one pass and reaches up to 6.14x lossless speedup on Qwen3-8B. The post Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: FlashMap 是由 Polymathic AI、普林斯頓大學與南加州大學資訊科學研究所（USC ISI）研究人員共同開發的推測式解碼草擬器。它能在一次傳遞中聯合草擬 16 個 Token，在 Qwen3-8B 上實現高達 6.14 倍的無損加速。這篇 Polymathic AI 與普林斯頓大學研究人員發布 FlashMap（用於實現快 6.14 倍 LLM 解碼的流圖草擬器）最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: 微軟推出AI代理防護新機制，依風險動態調整權限
items_all_raw.summary: 隨著AI代理（AI agent）逐漸取得企業資料、應用程式及系統的存取許可權，微軟於10月19日宣佈推出新一波AI代理防護機制，主張企業應將AI代理視為可能帶來內部風險的行動者，即使代理未遭外部入侵，也可能因判斷錯誤或受到惡意輸入影響而執行非預期操作。
